from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.metadata as metadata
import json
import platform
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import jax
import numpy as np

import phydrax
from phydrax.backends import cuda_environment
from phydrax.backends.atomistic import pallas_atomistic_availability
from tests.unit.atomistic.test_mace_acceleration import (
    _accelerated_aggregate,
    _coupling,
    _operands,
    _reference,
    _relation,
)


def main() -> None:
    report = cuda_environment()
    if not report.successful:
        raise RuntimeError(str(report))
    device = jax.devices("gpu")[0]
    if str(device.compute_capability) != "10.3":
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected B300 capability 10.3, observed {device}")
    availability = pallas_atomistic_availability("cuda")
    if not availability.available:
        raise RuntimeError(availability.reason)
    cases = []
    for precision in ("float32", "float64"):
        dtype = np.float32 if precision == "float32" else np.float64
        product, source, harmonics, radial = _operands(dtype)
        coupling = _coupling(precision, "deterministic", target="cuda")
        relation = _relation("deterministic")

        def apply(source: jax.Array, harmonics: jax.Array, radial: jax.Array) -> jax.Array:
            return _accelerated_aggregate(coupling, relation, product, source, harmonics, radial)

        compiled = jax.jit(apply).lower(source, harmonics, radial).compile()
        observed = jax.block_until_ready(compiled(source, harmonics, radial))
        expected = _reference(product, source, harmonics, radial)
        tolerance = 2e-5 if precision == "float32" else 1e-12
        np.testing.assert_allclose(observed, expected, rtol=tolerance, atol=tolerance)
        cases.append({"precision": precision, "maximum_absolute_error": float(np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(observed) - np.asarray(expected)))), "device": str(observed.device)})
    result = {"python": sys.version, "machine": platform.machine(), "device": device.device_kind, "compute_capability": str(device.compute_capability), "runtime_version": report.facts.runtime_version, "driver_version": report.facts.driver_version, "cuda_issues": [issue.code for issue in report.issues], "phydrax_path": phydrax.__file__, "packages": {name: metadata.version(name) for name in ("jax", "jaxlib", "jax-cuda13-plugin", "jax-cuda13-pjrt")}, "compiled_mace": cases, "successful": True}
    Path(".tmp/b300-runtime-smoke.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
